title: Estimate Overage Credit Worksheet — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Line under review.** For Service Accounts and Repair Orders, the overage is reviewed when a repair order is paid: the paid repair order is the repair order of the latest payment received on the account, and the line reviewed is the concern line of its latest authorized estimate decision. Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. Where no payment has been received on the account, or the paid repair order carries no authorized estimate decision, there is no line to review and no overage credit.

**Inputs.**
- *Billed amount* — the line's customer-pay labor and parts charges.
- *Authorized amount* — the estimate amount of the line's latest authorized decision.
- *Estimate tolerance* — the estimate overage tolerance of the account's tier, from the tier's estimate figures.

**Clause.** The overage credit is the billed amount less the authorized amount increased by the estimate tolerance, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. "Increased by the estimate tolerance" means the authorized amount multiplied by one plus the tolerance.

**Assembly.** The credit is assembled in this order: first the overage beyond the tolerance is found, never below zero; then every rate this policy sets out that increases the overage is applied to it; then, only where the overage is above zero, every dollar amount this policy sets out is added to it; and the sum is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, never less than one cent where the line is billed beyond the tolerance.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, tolerance 10%)
| Authorized amount | Authorized amount increased by the tolerance | Billed amount | Overage credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 880.00 | 905.37 | 25.37 |
| 800.00 | 880.00 | 880.00 | none |
| 800.00 | 880.00 | 880.01 | 0.01 |
| 800.00 | 880.00 | 846.20 | none (below zero is held at zero) |
